grh_3506c2cbb2d29adf1461.title: Chicago Deadline
paragraphs: Chicago reporter Ed Adams finds a young woman named Rosita dead of tuberculosis in a cheap hotel room and becomes obsessed with the address book she leaves behind. Working backward through its names, Ed discovers that Rosita had crossed paths with gamblers, wealthy financier G. G. Temple, gangster Sully Wellman, Blackie Franchot, John Spangler and others whose lives were damaged by the same violent circle. Temple had once struck Rosita and, believing he had killed her, relied on Sully to dispose of the body. Rosita was actually alive, and Spangler hid her until his unwanted advances drove her away again. Sully later killed Blackie and Spangler, used the secret to terrorize Temple into suicide, and tries to make Ed his fourth victim when the reporter finally reconstructs the chain. Belle Dorsett shoots Sully before he can kill Ed. Wounded and hospitalized, Ed knows he has finally met Rositaâ€™s funeral deadline: her story will be printed, and a woman who died almost unnoticed will at least be understood.

[[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes [[person|alan-ladd|Alan Ladd]], [[person|raymond-burr|Raymond Burr]], Lewis Allen, and Jim Backus. Other credited names include Bill Cairn as director, Howard Wiley as producer, Richard Allen as radio adaptor, and Jimmy Wallington as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.47c43e9eb0213c63|RCA]].

grh_353798d0762a7fad2ed0.title: Saigon
paragraphs: After the war, pilot Larry Briggs learns that his badly wounded friend Mike Perry has only a few months to live. Larry and Pete Rocco decide not to tell Mike and instead take a lucrative flying job in the Orient so they can fill his remaining time with adventure. Their employer, Alex Maris, turns out to be a wanted war profiteer, and his secretary Susan Cleaver is carrying a briefcase containing roughly half a million dollars. Mike falls for Susan while Larry distrusts her, then Larry seizes the money and tries to force her away from Mike before the scheme destroys him. The groupâ€™s flight into Indochina draws police attention, Maris catches up with them, and the criminal plot collapses in violence. Pete is killed, Mike dies from his condition, and Maris is shot. With the money recovered and the police satisfied, Larry and Susan leave Saigon together, both chastened by the lives lost around them.

grh_35340956f237a0075732.title: Quartette in Nothing Flat
paragraphs: Recently released criminals Al and Sid recruit lock expert Waxy and getaway driver Madame Olga for an absurd plan to hijack a DC-10. They dismantle realistic plastic toy guns so Olga can carry the pieces through airport security, reassemble them aboard the plane and seize the aircraft, forcing pilot Henderson to fly east while the Air Force gives chase. The scheme unravels over the Atlantic when fuel runs low and the crew makes a blind landing in heavy fog. At first the gang mistakes the sheep outside for strange creatures and imagines it has reached another world, only to learn that it has landed in Sussex and is surrounded by British troops. The men finish the adventure in prison, Olga and Henderson end up together, and Al immediately begins dreaming up a new robbery inside the institution meant to reform him.

grh_359b70b09bfba5c8e073.title: The Man With The Paralyzed Arm
paragraphs: A drifting young man calling himself Homer Moore arrives in Rivers End with one arm apparently paralyzed and a string of inconsistent stories about his past. His deep knowledge of music finally gives him away: Dr. Christian discovers that Homer is actually a composer and pianist whose career ended after an automobile accident. Homer had spent his life terrified that an injury would someday take away the hand he needed to play, and after the accident that fear became so powerful that he accepted the arm as permanently useless even though Christian can find no physical reason for the paralysis. To break the belief, Christian pretends to spill dangerous acid and cries for a towel. Homer instinctively grabs it with the supposedly useless hand. Christian reveals that the 'acid' was only distilled water and explains that the arm had remained physically sound. Freed from the fear that had trapped him, Homer can move his hand again and realizes he can return to music.

This [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]] broadcast aired on February 6, 1938. It is listed as episode 14 in the archive. [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Jean Hersholt and Rosemary De Camp.
The surviving recording runs about 29 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].

grh_3589f93a6fd0c0a35a61.title: Pitfall
paragraphs: Insurance investigator John Forbes is bored with the routine of suburban marriage when his work brings him to Mona Stevens, who received expensive gifts bought with money embezzled by her imprisoned boyfriend. John should simply recover the property, but attraction leads to a brief affair that he hides from his wife Sue. Private detective MacDonald, already obsessed with Mona, discovers the relationship and begins threatening both John and Mona. After the embezzler is released, the jealous and increasingly violent chain of events reaches Johnâ€™s home, where John kills the armed man in self-defense while Mona shoots MacDonald. John finally tells the police and then Sue the whole truth. Sue considers leaving him but decides that one terrible lapse should not automatically erase an otherwise good marriage, and the couple agree to try to rebuild what his deception damaged.

grh_35458cc582a33abd53d4.title: The Case of the Accidental Murderess
paragraphs: Watson initially fears Alice Markham may be repeating the suspicious history of her first marriage after a series of apparent accidents surrounds her second husband Jeffrey. Holmes reverses the suspicion and shows that Jeffrey Markham engineered the pattern himself: he had previously caused the death that enriched Alice, poisoned her first husband Dangerfield, and is now trying to kill Alice while making each attack look accidental. Markham also fires the second rifle shot that wounds Holmes while Alice is shooting at the same moment, and the accumulated evidence sends him to the gallows.

grh_35ad379c9fa5dd774e60.title: A Very Private Phone Call
paragraphs: Wealthy Howard Williams believes the men in his family sometimes revive after apparent death and arranges a red telephone so his wife Laura can be alerted if it happens to him. After his funeral, Laura is instructed to remain near the phone, but her fear of loneliness quickly gives way to the attentions of a bachelor business representative who promises to escort her around the world. As she becomes absorbed in plans for travel and companionship, the red telephone begins ringing in the next room. Laura ignores it and leaves, never realizing the call may be the one Howard warned her to answer.

grh_3531705b43abc218b9be.title: My Favorite Wife
paragraphs: Nick Arden has his wife Ellen legally declared dead after years missing at sea and immediately marries Bianca, only for Ellen to return alive from the shipwreck. Nick cannot find a way to tell his new bride, while Ellen disguises herself as an old family friend and becomes jealous when she learns another survivor shared her island exile. grh_351f3ccf44d1acbaf7cc.title: Overnight Guest
paragraphs: Young ex-Navy veteran Steve Corey comes to Hollywood dreaming of becoming an actor and meets Vicki Lipton in an acting class. Broke and homeless, he becomes Vicki's temporary houseguest until her insistence that he take responsibility for himself finally sinks in.
